faqs.q: Sec. 42-52. - I.F.C. Section 308.1.4, Open-flame cooking devices.
faqs.a:
Section 308.1.4. Open-flame cooking devices
, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"308.1.4. Open-flame cooking devices.
Charcoal burners and other open-flame cooking devices shall not be operated on combustible
                  balconies or within 10 feet (3048mm) of combustible construction.
Exceptions:
1.
One- and two-family dwellings.
2.
Where buildings, balconies or decks are protected by an approved automatic sprinkler
                     system."
3.
Gas burners having L-P gas container with a water capacity up to twenty (20) pounds
                     (9.1kg) L-P gas capacity may be used on combustible construction."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
